description: Route an inbound support ticket to a team and flag urgency and sentiment.

team.instructions: Which team should own this ticket, based on its subject and body?

criteria.billing: Payments, invoices, refunds and subscription changes.
criteria.technical: Product errors, outages, integration and API problems.
criteria.account: Login, access, roles and account administration.
criteria.other: None of the above categories apply.

urgent.instructions: Is this ticket time-sensitive and in need of a fast response?

criteria.true: Mentions an outage, a deadline, lost revenue, or an angry customer.
criteria.false: A routine question or a feature request with no time pressure.

sentiment.instructions: How positive is the customer's tone?
